name: Idea Management
description: A complete idea approval system that allows users to submit ideas for review, while managers can approve, reject, or confirm them with clear status updates. Role-based access controls define who can review or manage ideas. Automated email notifications are sent for idea requests, approvals, and rejections, ensuring real-time communication between users and managers.
summary: A smart and scalable idea management system designed to simplify idea submission and review across teams. Enable structured collaboration with a built-in idea approval , customizable workflows, and automated approval notifications. Track every stage of innovation from idea rejection and confirmation to final execution using a complete feedback and idea tracking solution that supports employee idea management, innovation workflows, and decision-making.

name: POS Minimum Order
description: Set a minimum order amount in your POS system to ensure smooth operations. When the order total is below the set limit, the payment button is automatically disabled. Once the amount exceeds the minimum order value, the payment option is enabled, helping you enforce order policies with ease.
summary: Set a minimum order amount in your POS system to optimize checkout and streamline operations. When the order total is below the set threshold, the payment button is automatically disabled, preventing incomplete transactions. Once the order exceeds the minimum value, the payment option becomes available, ensuring compliance with your business policies and improving efficiency. This feature helps enhance profitability and maintain smooth operations for both customers and staff. Implementing a minimum order amount in your POS system is an effective way to streamline checkout and ensure smoother operations. By setting a threshold, the payment button is automatically disabled for orders below the minimum, preventing customers from completing transactions that don't meet your business’s requirements. Once the total exceeds the minimum order value, the payment option is enabled, allowing customers to finalize their purchases. This feature not only enforces order policies but also reduces small or low-margin sales that can strain resources. It helps maintain profitability while creating a seamless experience for both customers and staff. Additionally, it can be adjusted based on business needs, making it a flexible tool for better control over orders.
